description: Click an item in the tenant's hosted browser, capture the file download, and store it as a document. Supports PDF, ZIP, Office, CSV, images and other file formats. Required: steps (same safe named actions as browser_run_flow, including a goto) and download.selector for the final clickable item. Secrets are resolved from the tenant vault. Empty files, files over 25 MB, and HTML login/error pages masquerading as downloads are rejected before storage. Optional: download.wait_ms, stealth, title, entity/entity_id. Returns document_id, filename, MIME type and size; retrieve it with get_document_link.

download.description: Download trigger: selector of the item to click, optional wait_ms

selector.description: CSS selector of the final link or button that triggers the browser download.

wait_ms.description: Time to allow the download to begin/finish after the click (default 5000, max 30000).

entity.description: Record type to file the download against; use with entity_id

secrets.description: Name -> { provider, field } from the tenant vault.

stealth.description: Ask the browser to reduce automation signals (does not bypass CAPTCHAs)

steps.description: Browser actions as in browser_run_flow, including a goto

name: browser_download_file
